studies.title: SpaceX Inspiration4 Blood Serum Metabolic Panel and Immune/Cardiac Cytokine Arrays
studies.description: Comprehensive metabolic panel and multiplex cytokine/chemokine profiling from four commercial astronauts aboard the Inspiration4 mission (3-day low-Earth orbit, apogee ~585 km). Tracks circulating inflammatory, cardiac stress, and metabolic adaptation markers pre-flight, immediately post-flight, and across long-term recovery.
studies.mission_context: Inspiration4 Commercial Crew Mission (Crew Dragon Resilience, 3 days LEO)
studies.measurements_summary: Plasma cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha, VEGF), electrolytes, BUN, creatinine, troponin, and high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP).
studies.publication_citation: Beheshti, A., Mason, C. E., et al. (2024). The Space Omics and Medical Atlas (SOMA) accelerates space medicine. Nature, 632, 1158-1172.

studies.title: SpaceX Inspiration4 PBMC Profiling: Single-Cell RNA-seq, snATAC-seq, and Immune Repertoires
studies.description: Single-cell and single-nucleus multi-omic characterization of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from the 4-member Inspiration4 crew. Details transient immune dysregulation, T-cell receptor (TCR) clonality shifts, and gene expression recovery kinetics.
studies.mission_context: Inspiration4 Commercial Crew Mission (Crew Dragon Resilience, 3 days LEO)
studies.measurements_summary: Single-cell transcriptome counts across 18 PBMC sub-populations, chromatin accessibility peaks, and V(D)J immune receptor clonal frequencies.
studies.publication_citation: Mason, C. E., et al. (2024). Single-cell immune repertoire profiling of civilian spaceflight astronauts. Nature, 632, 1173-1185.

studies.title: Effects of 21 Days of Bed Rest on Human Skeletal Muscle Gene Expression
studies.description: Ground-based microgravity simulation using horizontal and head-down tilt (-6 degree HDT) bed rest to investigate muscle unloading, fiber atrophy, and recovery in healthy human subjects.
studies.mission_context: Ground-based Head-Down Tilt Bed Rest Study (-6 deg HDT, 21 days)
studies.measurements_summary: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy mRNA expression, slow-to-fast twitch fiber type shifts, and cross-sectional area changes.
studies.publication_citation: NASA Human Research Program & ESA Bed Rest Studies Consortium.

studies.title: Woman Skeletal Muscle Transcriptome with Bed Rest and Countermeasures
studies.description: Evaluates skeletal muscle gene expression in female subjects undergoing prolonged 60-day head-down tilt bed rest with nutritional and resistive/aerobic exercise countermeasures.
studies.mission_context: WISE-2005 60-day Female Bed Rest Study (Toulouse, France)
studies.measurements_summary: Soleus and vastus lateralis transcriptome shifts, proteolysis pathways, and countermeasure efficacy metrics.
studies.publication_citation: Edgerton, V. R., et al. (2007). Human muscle adaptation to bed rest and exercise countermeasures.

studies.title: Human Skeletal Muscle Tissue Chip Autonomous Payload on the ISS
studies.description: Autonomous 3D human skeletal muscle myobundle tissue chip flown on the International Space Station (SpaceX CRS-21) to model microgravity-induced sarcopenia, sarcomeric disorganization, and metabolic gene alterations.
studies.mission_context: ISS National Laboratory Expedition 64 (SpaceX CRS-21, 10 days microgravity)
studies.measurements_summary: Myotube diameter, twitch force kinetics, and RNA-Seq differential expression of sarcomeric and mitochondrial genes.
studies.publication_citation: Soman, P., et al. (2023). Microgravity-induced sarcopenia modeling using human muscle-on-a-chip. npj Microgravity, 9, 45.

studies.title: Spaceflight Effects on Human Vascular Smooth Muscle Cell Phenotype and Function
studies.description: Investigates phenotypic modulation, extracellular matrix remodeling, and vascular contractility in human primary vascular smooth muscle cells cultured aboard the International Space Station.
studies.measurements_summary: Alpha-SMA contractility markers, collagen/elastin turnover gene expression, and endothelial adhesion molecules.
studies.publication_citation: NASA Space Biology Program, Ames Research Center.

studies.title: T-Cell Activation in Microgravity Compared to 1g Gravity
studies.description: Flown on Space Shuttle Discovery (STS-131) and the ISS; demonstrates that microgravity significantly inhibits immediate early gene expression and protein kinase C (PKC) signaling cascades during human T-cell activation.
studies.measurements_summary: IL-2 transcription, c-jun/c-fos induction levels, and T-cell mitogenic responsiveness in microgravity vs 1g centrifuge control.
studies.publication_citation: Hughes-Fulford, M., et al. (2005). Microgravity inhibits immediate early gene expression in T-cells. FASEB J, 19, 1311-1313.

studies.title: Rodent Research-12: In Vivo Cardiac Transcriptomic Changes After 30-Day Spaceflight
studies.description: Evaluates left ventricular myocardial remodeling, cytoskeletal organization, and mitochondrial energetics in mice flown for 30 days aboard the International Space Station.
studies.mission_context: ISS Rodent Research-12 (RR-12 / TARBIS, 30 days on ISS)
studies.measurements_summary: Ventricular myocardial RNA-Seq counts, titin/myosin heavy chain ratios, and cardiac oxidative phosphorylation enzyme profiles.
studies.publication_citation: NASA Space Biology Program, Ames Research Center.

studies.title: Targeting Myostatin/Activin A Protects Against Muscle and Bone Loss During Spaceflight
studies.description: Rodent Research-19 (RR-19) spaceflight study evaluating systemic administration of ACVR2B/Fc decoy receptor in mice to prevent microgravity-induced musculoskeletal loss.
studies.mission_context: ISS Rodent Research-19 (SpaceX CRS-19, 33 days on ISS)
studies.measurements_summary: Trabecular and cortical volumetric bone mineral density (femur/tibia), soleus/gastrocnemius wet weights, and circulating myostatin levels.
studies.publication_citation: Lee, S. J., et al. (2020). Targeting myostatin/activin A protects against skeletal muscle and bone loss during spaceflight. PNAS, 117(39), 24411-24419.

studies.title: Rodent Research-7: Space Environment Impact on Gut Microbiota and Circadian Rhythms
studies.description: Mice flown on the ISS for 30 days were examined for disruptions in intestinal microbiome biodiversity and corresponding molecular shifts in hepatic and central circadian clock gene networks.
studies.mission_context: ISS Rodent Research-7 (SpaceX CRS-15, 30 days on ISS)
studies.measurements_summary: Relative bacterial taxon abundance, liver Clock, Bmal1, Per1, Per2, Cry1 gene expression, and circulating secondary bile acids.
studies.publication_citation: Vitaterna, M. H., Turek, F. W., et al. (2020). Circadian and metabolic rhythms in spaceflight. Cell Reports.

studies.title: Behavioral Changes and Circadian Timing in Rats Exposed to Microgravity in Utero
studies.description: Evaluated vestibular development, daily behavioral rhythmicity, and suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN) circadian pacemaker integrity in neonatal rats following gestational spaceflight on STS-66.
studies.mission_context: Space Shuttle STS-66 (NIH.R2 Payload, 11 days LEO)
studies.measurements_summary: Circadian period length, wheel-running activity power spectra, and VIP/vasopressin SCN neuron counts.
studies.publication_citation: Alberts, J. R., et al. (1996). Development of circadian pacemakers following microgravity exposure in utero. LSDA.

studies.title: Cumulative Impacts of Deep-Space Radiation, Confinement, and Altered Gravity
studies.description: Evaluates the combined triad of deep-space hazards: 33-beam simulated galactic cosmic radiation (SimGCRsim, 500 mGy), prolonged social isolation, and hindlimb unloading in murine models at NSRL.
studies.mission_context: NASA Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL) Ground Simulation Analog
studies.measurements_summary: Elevated Plus Maze anxiety index, Novel Object Recognition discrimination ratio, Morris Water Maze latency, and plasma IL-1beta/IL-6.
studies.publication_citation: Krukowski, K., Rosi, S., et al. (2021). Synergistic effects of space radiation and environmental stressors. Nat Commun, 12, 3941.

studies.title: Differential Impact of Social Isolation and Space Radiation on Behavior and Motor Learning
studies.description: Tests how social isolation housing and fractionated ion-beam irradiation independently and interactively impair rotarod motor learning, exploratory vigor, and neuroendocrine stress hormones.
studies.mission_context: NASA Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL) Mars Transit Confinement Simulation
studies.measurements_summary: Rotarod fall latency, open-field center occupancy time, and plasma corticosterone concentrations.
studies.publication_citation: NASA Human Research Program Behavioral Health & Performance Element.

studies.title: Biological Responses Following Simulated GCR Exposure Combined with Microgravity
studies.description: Simultaneous 33-ion beam Galactic Cosmic Ray simulation (up to 500 mGy) and 30-day hindlimb unloading to assess hematopoietic stem cell survival, DNA double-strand break repair kinetics, and bone marrow cytogenetics.
studies.mission_context: NASA Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL) GCRsim + Hindlimb Unloading
studies.measurements_summary: HSPC frequency, nuclear gamma-H2AX double-strand breaks per cell, and chromosome translocation frequencies.
studies.publication_citation: NASA Space Radiation Program Element, Human Research Program.

studies.title: Deep Space Radiation Impacts on Cognitive Performance and Microglial Activation
studies.description: Evaluates sex-dimorphic neurological vulnerability, persistent microglial activation, and cognitive performance deficits in mice following low-dose galactic cosmic radiation at NSRL.
studies.mission_context: NASA Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL) Galactic Cosmic Ray Simulation
studies.measurements_summary: Barnes maze primary latency and search errors, Iba-1 positive microglial cell counts, and hippocampal cytokine transcript levels.
studies.publication_citation: Rosi, S., et al. (2020). Sex-specific cognitive deficits following galactic cosmic ray exposure. Science Advances, 6(42), eabb9379.
